full_judgment:
Mr. Md. Delwar Hossain, J:- This Rule was issued upon an application under section 5 of the Limitation Act calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the delay of 991 days in filing the criminal appeal against the judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 18.5.200 passed by the Metropolitan Additional Sessions Judge, Court No.3 Dhaka should not be condoned and/or pass such other order or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 2. The petitioner was convicted under section 302/34 of the Penal Code and sentenced to suffer imprisonment for life and to pay a fine of Tk.10,000/- in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 1 year. The petitioner being aggrieved by the impugned judgment and order of conviction and sentence preferred a criminal appeal and in preferring the same a delay of 991 day has been caused for which he has filed an application under section 5 of the Limitation Act for condoning the said delay.
